name: Celebration Catering
description: Celebration Catering is a locally owned and operated full-service food and beverage company managed by A Restaurant Group. We have hosted more than 500 events from small family gatherings to large 20,000 guest events. Celebration Catering has designed and executed more than 500 events, from small family gatherings to 20,000-guest events. Our culinary team works with several area wedding planning companies of your choice or we can recommend some of the best. Your event may be hosted at one of our six exclusive locations or we will cater to any Gulf Coast area location of your choice. We are best known for exceptional quality food and artful presentations. Our company runs some of the finest restaurant concepts on the gulf coast under the Sassy Bass brands. We operate a grocery market and liquor store with a selection of over 2,000 wines. Buying from the 3 largest food suppliers & the largest coop grocery store provider giving us unlimited resources and purchasing power.
